newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-ICTSI downgraded to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ICTSI downgraded to sell.

text.p: Paribas Asia Equity had downgraded its recommendation on International Container Terminal Services Inc to a sell, a Paribas report released on Friday said.
Paribas said the port operator was trading at expensive levels -- 59 percent over the market price-earnings ratio (P/E) based on 1997 earnings and 88 percent higher based on 1998 forecast earnings.
It added that a weaker peso would cut its earnings due to the fixed fee paid to the port regulator and high dollar-denominated debts.
"ICTSI usually trades at a premium to the market. However, a huge premium of 59 percent and 88 percent...vis-a-vis the market is simply too much," it said.
"We believe the stock should be a sell as it is a clear loser with a depreciating currency scenario," it added.
